checkpoint.title: From anywhere outdoors: a shiny Voltorb in Route 10's grass by the wild RNG, stored in the PC, back to the nurse

events.why: The catch's summary needs a party slot. This stores Rattata, the Sevii save's weakest member, which no catch needs: the first member holding no Mail (the other role the PC knows) would be Blastoise, the party's Surf and Strength.
Into the north grass, where Sweet Scent finds Voltorb, Spearow and Ekans.
The wild RNG's hard reset boots from this save, in the grass.

A shiny Voltorb, the soonest of the table for TID 33002 and SID 9011 (read once from the save's memory). seed_offset 8: what this checkpoint's grass save (the save file's 139th) adds to the table's seeds on mGBA, measured from it. The party's last member knows Sweet Scent.
Stores the catch, so the party is five again with the Sweet Scent member last, as the next catch needs.
Sweet Scent's PP back at the nurse.
Outdoors, where the next catch starts.

metadata.notes: mGBA only. The seed offset holds for this checkpoint's start save as the program's chain leaves it (from sevii_story's end, two saves a catch): a start save with another number of saves before it boots a few timer counts off and misses, failing the checkpoint (wild_rng_not_shiny) with the catch unsaved. Starts with the Sevii story's full party; make_room leaves five, with Oddish (Sweet Scent) last.
